title: Interaction-order tomography modulo parent symmetry

object.measurements: passive conditional sum and every perfect-intervention conditional sum fixing S with |S|<=r; integer sums are stored
object.equivalent_coordinates: unnormalised Walsh coefficients of degree <=r, related to the conditional means by exact Fourier inversion and fixed nonzero row scaling
object.gauge_group: B_n = Sym(n) semidirect (Z/2)^n acting by parent-coordinate permutations and input-sign flips; intervention labels transform with the same action
object.output_labels: semantic -1 and +1; output complementation is not gauge

predeclared_theorems.design_rank: rank A_(n,r) = sum_{j=0}^r binomial(n,j), with kernel spanned by Walsh characters of degree >r
predeclared_theorems.labelled_threshold: on the full Boolean class, the smallest uniformly identifying order is r=n
predeclared_theorems.quotient_threshold: for n>=2, on the full Boolean class modulo B_n, the smallest uniformly identifying order is r=n-1
predeclared_theorems.minimum_cost_basis: for degree<=k mechanisms, minimum row count is D(n,k) and minimum total fixed-coordinate cost is sum_{j=1}^k j binomial(n,j); one all-positive assignment for every |S|<=k attains it

rank_and_basis.arithmetic: exact modular rank over prime 2147483647; a full-column-rank result equals rational rank because the column upper bound is D(n,r)

boolean_quotient_census.arithmetic: exact integer truth tables, conditional sums, and Walsh coefficients

gates.G1: every registered full intervention design has exact rank D(n,r)
gates.G2: the direct conditional-sum identity 2^|S| m_sum(S,a) = sum_{T subseteq S} W_T chi_T(a) has zero mismatches on every Boolean truth table in the n=2..4 census
gates.G3: the observed labelled identifiability threshold equals n for every n=2..4
gates.G4: the observed B_n-quotient identifiability threshold equals n-1 for every n=2..4
gates.G5: for every n=2..4 and r<=n-2, registered parity functions of degrees r+1 and r+2 collide but occupy distinct gauge orbits; at r=n-1 the parity/negative-parity collision occupies one orbit
gates.G6: the greedy minimum-weight vector-matroid basis has D(n,r) rows and the exact analytic total cost on every registered rank/basis cell
gates.G7: the output path is non-aliasing and write-once, and a SHA-256 sidecar is emitted
gates.G8: the run records argv and registration commit, verifies source/protocol/theorem bytes equal committed blobs before enumeration, and rejects pre/post hash changes
gates.G9: the executed grid, gauge, measurement semantics, output-label semantics, and gate universe exactly match the registered protocol fields

descriptive_not_gated.conditioning: 2-norm condition numbers for the minimum-cost zeta basis and the redundant all-assignments design
descriptive_not_gated.collision_counts: numbers and maximum multiplicities of labelled and quotient-ambiguous signatures

claim_boundary: The proofs establish the finite universal statements. A pass verifies only the registered bounded implementation and exact n<=4 Boolean quotient census. It does not establish transformer interaction coordinates, VPD efficacy, noisy sample complexity, or a generic ASMP-1 solution.
